name: smwmusic-sacred-harp-sons-of-sorrow-meantone-1
title: Sacred Harp - Sons of sorrow (meantone 1/3)
description:
Janno27 said the melody was similar to renaissance music counterpoint in the original submission. I then tried to apply renaissance music's temperaments, and this came off as the best fit, since it has an effect on the minor thirds of the song.

More info: Meantone temperaments, see 1/3 syntonic comma.

Also thanks to my pal Darkbloom for helping me figuring out the pitches.
